text:
mohit: hey team, heads up — ran the canary for PR #8412 (prefill/kv-refactor) and I'm seeing a p95 jump on 4k longseq. numbers below, linking artifacts shortly :/

ci-bot: canary results uploaded: https://ci.redwood/example/artifacts/8412/canary-report.html (summary: p50 32ms -> 34ms, p95 68ms -> 112ms, mem 1.9GB -> 2.4GB)

anna: thanks — do we know if this is alloc churn or a KV cache hotpath regression?

mohit: initial flamegraphs point at prefill path and a new loop in kv-shard. suspect extra memcpy on prefill when tiling kicks in.

kevin: can you paste the bench command you used? quick repro so i can try on metal.

mohit: command: `./bench/run_longseq.sh --model=gpt-4k --seq=4096 --clients=16 --iters=500 --commit=pr/8412`

lucy: did you run adaptive-batcher config? sometimes that hides pressure.

mohit: default canary config. also validated with `--clients=1` and p95 still ~105ms so not purely batching.

anna: can you dump `ps` and `nvprof` for one sample? even a HEAPTRACE would help.

mohit: attached small logs and a heaptrace link in the CI artifact page. main diff is this loop: ```c++
for (auto &shard : shards) {
  memcpy(dst, shard.prefetch_buf, shard.size); // new path
}
```

kevin: that memcpy on large shards would explain mem spike. maybe we can pre-allocate and move pointers instead.

lucy: alternative quick mitigation — fall back to old prefill path when seq>2048, until we fix. low-risk short-term.

mohit: agreed. opening a hotpatch PR now. will add a canary that gates on seq threshold.

kevin: can you include microbench that isolates memcpy cost? `perf record -g` + small harness is fine. I can review tonight.

mohit: yep will add perf and paste results.

ci-bot: deploy-canary: canary started on 3 hosts (canary-id: c-2023-09-14-43). logs: https://ci.redwood/example/logs/c-2023-09-14-43

anna: thx — once you have the hotpatch PR link drop it here and ping for 2nd review. prefer small diff with fallback flag.

mohit: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/8420 — small conditional. added bench output sample in description. asking for 2 reviewers @kevin @lucy :thumbsup:

kevin: looking now. quick scan — add a unit test for seq boundary and a comment explaining tradeoff.

lucy: if tests are green I'll approve. also file a perf ticket so we don't forget to optimize memcpy later (perf-2023-1122).

mohit: will do both. thanks all 

anna: fyi, scheduling a short async postmortem doc in #eng-runtime-docs so we capture root cause and next steps.

kevin: sounds good. if it helps i can pair on optimizing the tiling logic tomorrow morning.

mohit: appreciated — i'll re-run the canary after patch lands and post updated CI artifact.

lucy: :white_check_mark:
